description: This file defines a static factory method for creating a shared pointer to a WebAudioPlayerFactoryMock object, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerFactory interface. It is part of the firebolt::rialto namespace and uses Google Test's StrictMock for mocking behavior.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerFactoryMock
classes.description: A mock class for WebAudioPlayerFactory used in testing, derived from IWebAudioPlayerFactory.

methods.name: IWebAudioPlayerFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a singleton shared pointer to a StrictMock WebAudioPlayerFactoryMock object.
